messages:
Sam: Heads up team 
I'll be out on vacation next week (Mon-Wed) but my birthday is Friday — anyone around want to drop a tiny office cake or confetti? No stress if not.
people-ops-bot: Reminder: Office birthday requests should be posted in #people-ops so folks can coordinate. Add to the shared sign-up if you'd like in-office help.
Jules: Im nearby that Friday and can bring something small 370. Also happy to pick up a card.
Nora: I can chip in for a cake. Whats your favorite? Chocolate or lemon?
Sam: Chocolate please 36b but mini cupcakes are great too. Also, nothing big 60a
Devon: Quick poll 4dd react to this: :chocolate_bar: chocolate cupcakes, :lemon: lemon, :cupcake: mixed mini cupcakes.
people-ops-bot: people-ops ledger note: suggested per-person contribution $10-20. Sign-up: https://tinyurl.com/redwood-bday-signup
Jules: If any remotes want to send a short video clip we can play it during a 10-min cake break at 3pm PT. Nora, can you reserve the little conference spot?
Nora: Reserved huddle room B 2:45-3:15pm PT.
Sam: Aww you guys this is so sweet 970 No need for videos but thank you. Ill drop by the office if possible.
Devon: Adding a note: if you want a vegan/dairy-free option, add it on the sign-up sheet.
Jules: I'll handle ordering cupcakes. ETA pickup at 2:30pm.
people-ops-bot: Sign-up updated by Jules. Last edit: 1790012401.
Nora: Tiny card ideas welcome. I can write a group note.
Sam: "Happy birthday Sam! Thanks for making our Slack slightly funnier." :)
Devon: "Keep being the spreadsheet whisperer 4dd64c"
Jules: "Happy birthday! More cake, less bug reports." :stuck_out_tongue:
people-ops-bot: Final tally: chocolate cupcakes 9, lemon 1, mixed 2. Cupcakes ordered.
Sam: Youre all ridiculous and I love you. See you Friday 389
